scope: Independent recomputation of each recorded FSM regime from exact event timestamps, without calling the new analysis or decoder functions. Raw chunk completeness was audited in the source reports; that simulation audit is not repeated here.

checks: source SHA-256 values and decoder provenance match
trial IDs and units are unique and complete
events sorted, no duplicates, all timestamps within horizon
all quarter counts, decoded vectors and optimum scores independently recomputed
every retained interval uses one unit and one identical optimum through T
unreadable/nonoptimal/different-vector regimes break continuity
duration cutoff is >=100000, with all 512 trials in denominator
all plotted counts recomputed from individual trial starts; endpoint agrees
no curve increase after T-100000
